g.text: Development benign generation: acceptance is not correctness
12 authored task units · 1 replicates · 48 candidate outcomes · equal attempt/token budgets.
Intervals resample tasks, retaining paired arms and replicates. Complexity slices are descriptive; this is a narrow synthetic benchmark.
